Messages.Author: gl...@runet.edu
Messages.Body:
This question is for [LSJ] or anyone else who knows the answer. The
Wizards of the Coast Web Site Card List for DS lists a card: Vial of
Methuselah Vitae, however most of the other card lists on the net do
not list this card. I have the complete set of DS except for this
card. I was wondering if the card really exists and if so is it a
regular booster card or was it a promo card? According to Eric Cagle
at cust...@wizards.com it does exist. However I was informed by
someone on this newsgroup that ques...@wizards.com says the card
does not exist. If anyone could answer this question I would be very
happy. Also if it does exist and anyone has it to trade PLEASE e-mail
me.

Gary Lee
gl...@runet.edu

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:


It does not exist.
The WotC web site didn't used to list it.
(I refer to http://www.wizards.com/Cardlists/VTES/Dark_Sovereigns.txt)

From a copy of the file I downloaded in Sep. 1996:
...
Ventrue Directorate Assembly
Vial of Elder Vitae
Vial of Garou Blood
Victoria
...

But now:

...
Ventrue Directorate Assembly
Vial of Elder Vitae
Vial of Garou Blood
Vial of Methuselah Vitae
Victoria
...

I know of no physical instance of this card, however.
It only exists, to the best of my knowledge, in a few lists.
It wasn't actually printed. (*)

--
L. Scott Johnson (vte...@regency.wizards.com)
Official VtES Net.Rep for Wizards of the Coast.
(*) - Subject to review by Rules Team

Messages.Author: Martin Ward
Messages.Body:
Re: Vial of Methuselah Vitae

LSJ answered your question, but I would like to add that it was mentioned in a
Duelist (that came out the same time as DS) that this card had got left out of
the set, due to error or maybe it was too powerful, I'm not sure which. It was
said that it may be put into another expansion. Well, since there aren't any
expansions in the works, I guess we'll never see it.

Messages.Author: Kristofer Wårell
Messages.Body:


I guess it was ruled as too powerful, just look at the card text on
Wizard's
site:

Vial of Methuselah Vitae
2 pool
Equipment
Unique equipment. If a vampire is equipped with this Vial, you may burn
this
card. If the vampire is in combat, the vampire gains 4 blood and all
further
damage done to the vampire during that combat is prevented; otherwise,
he or
she only gains 4 blood. Only one Vial of Methuselah Vitae may be played
in a
game.
Richard Thomas
Rare

For 2 pool and an equip action you make a vampire not only invulnerable
in
one combat (which would have been bad enough for 2 pool). He/she also
gets
4 blood, equals to two rounds of hunting and use of a hunting ground
(with
exceptions like Inbase Discotek, Aaron's Feeding Razor, Amadeo and The
Hungry
Coyote). Also with the option to burn it to get 4 blood when not in
combat.

Just my opinion.
